trip_name: Autumn in Korea: 23-Day Public Transport Adventure
summary: An optimized 23-day itinerary covering Seoul, Busan, and a 3rd City (default: Gyeongju, with alternates Jeju Island and Jeonju). Structured for maximum cost efficiency and effortless transit using T-money, WOWPASS, and KTX.

days.title: Arrival at Incheon Airport (ICN) & Check-In
days.transport_mode: AREX Express Train or Airport Limousine Bus
days.details: Arrive at Incheon T1/T2. Pick up your prepaid WOWPASS or buy a T-money card at the airport CU/GS25 store. Take the AREX Express non-stop to Seoul Station (43-51 min) or an Airport Limousine Bus directly to your hotel neighborhood.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Just like taking Narita Express (N'EX) to Shinjuku or BART from SFO to downtown SF.

days.title: Historic Palaces & Bukchon Hanok Village (Peak Autumn Foliage)
days.transport_mode: Seoul Subway (Line 3 - Gyeongbokgung / Anguk Station)
days.transit_card_used: Seoul Climate Card (Tourist Edition) or T-money
days.details: Explore Gyeongbokgung Palace, Changdeokgung Secret Garden, and Bukchon Hanok Village. Enjoy incredible yellow ginkgo trees and red maples.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Seoul subway turnstiles require tapping ON and OFF. If you activated a 5-day Seoul Climate Card (15,000 KRW/person), all subway and bus rides today are 100% covered!

days.title: Myeongdong, N Seoul Tower & Cheonggyecheon Stream Night Walk
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 4 (Myeongdong Station) + Namsan circulation bus 01A/01B
days.details: Take the green Namsan circulation bus 01A/01B up to N Seoul Tower for sunset city views (no private taxis allowed on Namsan mountain!). Walk Myeongdong night market.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Korea's circular green buses tag on/off just like city subways.

days.title: Hongdae Youth Culture, Yeonnam-dong & Han River Park
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 2 (Green Line - Hongik Univ Station)
days.details: Explore the vibrant indie music, fashion, and cafe streets of Hongdae and Gyeongui Line Forest Park. In the late afternoon, take Subway Line 5 to Yeouido Hangang Park for riverside ramen.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Line 2 is a circular loop line, identical to Tokyo's Yamanote Line!

days.title: Gangnam, COEX Starfield Library & Bongeunsa Temple
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 2 / Line 9 (Express Trains)
days.details: Cross the Han River south to Gangnam. Ride Subway Line 9 (be sure to check whether your train is All-Stop or Express!). Visit COEX Mall and peaceful Bongeunsa Temple.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Line 9 has Express (Red text) and All-Stop trains on the same track—like NYC subway express lines or Japan's Rapid vs Local trains.

days.title: Day Trip Option: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress or DMZ Tour
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 1 or ITX-Saemaeul Train to Suwon Station
days.transit_card_used: T-money (for Subway Line 1) or KORAIL ticket
days.details: Take a 30-minute ITX train from Seoul Station to Suwon to walk the magnificent 18th-century Hwaseong Fortress walls, or join a verified DMZ morning shuttle.
days.sf_japan_bridge: ITX trains are comfortable reserved-seat regional trains, similar to JR Limited Express trains.

days.title: Insadong Traditional Tea Houses & Gwangjang Market Food Tour
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 1 (Jongno 5-ga Station) / Walking
days.details: Taste bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), mayak gimbap, and kalguksu at Gwangjang Market. Stroll the traditional arts alleys of Insadong.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Use WOWPASS or cash for market stalls.

days.title: KTX High-Speed Train to Busan & Haeundae Beach
days.transport_mode: KTX Train (Seoul Station -> Busan Station) + Busan Metro Line 1 & 2
days.transit_card_used: KORAIL Saver Pass / Individual KTX Ticket + T-money
days.details: Board the 09:00 KTX from Seoul Station, arriving Busan Station at 11:30. Take Busan Metro Line 1 to Seomyeon, transfer to Line 2 to Haeundae Beach. Check into hotel and walk the coastal promenade.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Your T-money or WOWPASS works on Busan subways and buses without any extra registration!

days.title: Haeundae Blue Line Park Beach Train & Haedong Yonggungsa Seaside Temple
days.transport_mode: Haeundae Beach Train / Sky Capsule + Busan Bus #181 or Kakao T Taxi
days.transit_card_used: Visit Busan Pass / T-money / Kakao T
days.details: Ride the picturesque coastal train from Mipo to Songjeong. Take Bus 181 or a 10-minute Kakao T taxi to Haedong Yonggungsa, Korea's most stunning temple built on ocean cliffs.
days.sf_japan_bridge: If you buy the Visit Busan Pass (24h or 48h), the Beach Train ride is included free!

days.title: Gamcheon Culture Village & Jagalchi Seafood Market
days.transport_mode: Busan Metro Line 1 (Toseong Station) + Town Bus Saha 1-1 / 2-2
days.details: Take a colorful micro-bus up the steep hills to Gamcheon Culture Village (the 'Machu Picchu of Busan'). Descend to Jagalchi Market and BIFF Square for seafood and sseed hotteok.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Town buses (Maeul-bus) are smaller neighborhood shuttles—always hold onto grab handles as Busan's hills are steep!

days.title: Gwangalli Beach, Gwangan Bridge Views & Shinsegae Centum City
days.transport_mode: Busan Metro Line 2 (Gwangan / Centum City Stations)
days.details: Relax at Spa Land (luxury Korean jjimjilbang sauna inside Shinsegae Centum City). Evening stroll along Gwangalli Beach for illuminated Gwangan Bridge views.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Subway Line 2 connects all eastern coastal hubs.

days.title: Taejongdae Cliff Trails & Songdo Cable Car
days.transport_mode: Busan Bus #8 / #30 or Kakao T Taxi
days.details: Visit scenic Taejongdae Resort Park on Yeongdo Island and ride the Songdo Marine Cable Car over the ocean.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Busan's coastal buses offer scenic ocean views.

days.title: 35-Minute KTX Hop to Gyeongju: The Museum Without Walls
days.transport_mode: KTX/SRT (Busan Station -> Singyeongju Station) + Bus #700
days.details: Board the KTX for a lightning-fast 35-minute ride to Singyeongju Station. Take Bus #700 (or a $12 Kakao T taxi) into Gyeongju historic center. Explore Daereungwon Tumuli Park (royal burial mounds) and Cheomseongdae Observatory.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Shorter than riding BART from SF to Oakland! (Note: If you choose Option B Jeju Island, take a 1 hr flight from Busan Gimhae Airport; if Option C Jeonju, take KTX/intercity bus).

days.title: Bulguksa Temple & Seokguram Grotto (Autumn Foliage Perfection)
days.transport_mode: Gyeongju Bus #10 / #11 or Kakao T Taxi
days.details: Take Bus #10 or #11 up to UNESCO World Heritage Bulguksa Temple and Seokguram Grotto. Early November is peak crimson maple season here! Evening walk around Donggung Palace & Wolji Pond.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Gyeongju buses announce major tourist stops in English, Japanese, and Chinese.

days.title: Hwangridan-gil Traditional Cafes & Gyochon Hanok Village
days.transport_mode: Walking / Shared Rental Bike
days.details: Stroll Hwangridan-gil, Gyeongju's trendy street of hanok cafes, street food, and artisan shops. Visit Woljeonggyo Bridge.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Gyeongju is flat and bike-friendly, similar to Kyoto.

days.title: Return KTX to Seoul & Check-in to Second Seoul Neighborhood
days.transport_mode: KTX High-Speed Train (Singyeongju Station -> Seoul Station)
days.details: Take the 2-hour KTX back to Seoul Station. Check into a new neighborhood (e.g. if you stayed in Myeongdong first, try Hongdae or Gangnam for part two!).
days.sf_japan_bridge: Seamless 2-hour train ride back to the capital.

days.title: Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) & Seongsu-dong ('The Brooklyn of Seoul')
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 2 (Seongsu Station)
days.details: Explore Seongsu-dong, a former shoemaking industrial district transformed into Seoul's coolest cafe, fashion pop-up, and gallery neighborhood. Evening architectural walk at Zaha Hadid's DDP.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Vibe is similar to SF's Dogpatch/Mission or Tokyo's Shimokitazawa/Kuramae.

days.title: Lotte World Tower Seoul Sky & Seokchon Lake
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 2 / 8 (Jamsil Station)
days.details: Visit the 123-story Lotte World Tower and walk around Seokchon Lake. Visit the underground Lotte World Mall.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Direct subway access inside Jamsil Station.

days.title: National Museum of Korea & Yongsan Park
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 4 (Ichon Station - Underground Walkway)
days.details: Spend the day at the National Museum of Korea (free general admission!) featuring magnificent national treasures and tranquil reflecting ponds.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Direct climate-controlled underground tunnel from Ichon Station.

days.title: The Hyundai Seoul (Yeouido) & Han River Cruise
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 5 (Yeouinaru Station)
days.details: Visit 'The Hyundai Seoul', Korea's most spectacular modern indoor park and shopping complex. Enjoy an evening Eland Han River sunset cruise.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Modern architectural wonderland with world-class food court.

days.title: Eunpyeong Hanok Village & Bukhansan Mountain Foliage
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 3 (Yeonsinnae Station) + Bus #7211 / #701
days.details: Escape to the foot of Bukhansan Mountain at Eunpyeong Hanok Village for breathtaking autumn mountain vistas and 1-in-1-잔 (1 In 1 Jan) cafe.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Easy city bus connection from Line 3.

days.title: Souvenir Shopping: Olive Young, Namdaemun & Lotte Mart Seoul Station
days.transport_mode: Subway Line 1 / 4
days.details: Stock up on K-beauty at Olive Young Flagship, Korean snacks (HBAF almonds, yakgwa, seaweed) at Lotte Mart Seoul Station, and traditional crafts at Namdaemun Market. Use Immediate Tax Refund at checkout!
days.sf_japan_bridge: Bring your passport to get instant 7-8% VAT tax deducted at cash registers!

days.title: Departure to Incheon Airport (ICN) & Flight Home
days.transport_mode: AREX Express Train (Seoul Station -> ICN T1/T2) or Airport Limousine Bus
days.details: If flying Korean Air, Asiana, or select airlines, use the Seoul Station City Airport Terminal to check your bags and clear immigration in downtown Seoul! Then take the AREX Express empty-handed to your departure gate.
days.sf_japan_bridge: Seoul Station's in-city check-in is one of the greatest travel hacks in the world!
